findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The change may intend every 'make no changes to X' to be a scope limit. Rejected: the predicate contract is wording that rules out a change, and NOEDIT4 treats bare 'make no changes' as that wording. Only a change verb elsewhere distinguishes the readings, and the predicate cannot see one.
findingDetails.case: prompt 'make no changes to any file, just report what you find': post-fix isNoEditRequest=false and attachCommand='/create:agent'; pre-fix isNoEditRequest=true and attachCommand=undefined
findingDetails.claim: The added negative lookahead disables the shared no-edit gate for genuine object-bearing no-edit requests, so a mutating hub command is offered where it was withheld before the commit.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Enumerated every other NO_EDIT_REQUEST alternative against the failing prompt; none matches. Read all three callers for a second check; none adds one. Ran the pre-commit module to confirm the guard fired before the change.
findingDetails.description: The added (?! (?:to|in)\b) makes the shared predicate false for every 'make no changes to <object>' sentence, including genuine no-edit requests, so a mutating command is offered where the pre-commit module withheld it.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade to P2 if the gate contract is amended to exclude every object-bearing form, or a caller is shown to re-add a change-verb check.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Changed line in a declared-scope file; attachCommand at command-attach.ts:335 and both scorer callers consume the same predicate, so the regression reaches every no-edit gate.
findingDetails.title: The 'make no changes' lookahead is over-broad: a genuine no-edit request that names its object loses the guard
